notes.title: Mall Mayhem 1.3 "First Person" Update Is Now Live
notes.content:
Mall Mayhem has received its 3rd patch! Some of the changes and bug fixes in this are based upon community feedback (thank you!). If you have any suggestions for the next patch, please leave them on the community discussions.
Patch Notes:
[list]
[*]Mall Mayhem now has a first person view! This view can be unlocked in The Shop. You can switch between third and first person view at any time once unlocked. Please note that this has replaced the cooldown upgrade due to some severe bugs.
[*]The Easter Egg is now much easier to unlock. Completionists rejoice!
[*]Fixed some collision and clipping issues with double door frames.
[*]Plus other very minor fixes that aren't worth mentioning on their own.
[/list]

notes.title: Mall Mayhem 1.2 "The Shop" Update Is Now Live
notes.content:
NOTE: I had some problems when uploading and launching this update on Steam. I fixed the problem on my end, but please reply to this announcement if you encounter any problems. I will resolve them as quickly as possible.

Demolishing malls just got an upgrade! This update features The Shop, a place where you complete challenges to upgrade your vehicle. The Shop includes upgrades to the engine, brakes, stability, ability cooldown, and drivetrain!
Patch Notes:
[list]
[*]Added The Shop as described above.
[*]Getting stuck on objects is now much harder. However, it will be easier to flip your car while performing tight maneuvers. This has been done to address game difficulty complaints without making the game too easy.
[*]The vehicle is now faster and stops more quickly (even without upgrades). This has been done to increase the overall pace of Mall Mayhem.
[*]8 new achievements have been added.
[*]Abilities can be selected with the scroll wheel or be remapped to keys.
[*]The camera can be controlled with the mouse.
[*]New lighting techniques have been implemented. Shadows on static objects are sharper and improve performance.
[*]The shopper AI has been slightly tweaked.
[*]Other minor performance and game enhancements.
[/list]
I will continue to improve Mall Mayhem as I see fit. Please help me out by posting suggestions in the Community Hub. Have fun!

notes.title: Mall Mayhem 1.1 Update Is Now Live
notes.content:
Mall Mayhem has recieved its first patch! The changes in this patch are based on community feedback. If you have any suggestions for the next patch, please leave them on the community discussions.
Patch Notes:
[list]
[*]Added a "retry" button on the Game Over screen.
[*]The player's car now has more ground clearance. This addresses the common complaint of getting stuck too often on small objects.
[*]Fixed the Titanium Game Studios splash screen. The splash screen will now cover the entire screen instead of sometimes leaving a small border around it.
[/list]
